% Pattern: env/numbered/article. An environment whose name ends in a star but
% that \newtheorem declares without one is numbered, and a title in a font
% command is read.
% seen in the gold pilot (set X)
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1 status=none
% want rem--1 remark 1
% want rem--2 remark 2
% want definition--1 definition 1
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{\noindent\textbf{Theorem}}
\theoremstyle{remark}
\newtheorem{rem*}{\noindent\textbf{Remark}}
\newtheorem{definition*}{\noindent\textbf{Definition}}
\begin{document}
\begin{theorem} Each tree is a graph. \end{theorem}
\begin{rem*} A path is a tree. \end{rem*}
\begin{rem*} A cycle is a graph. \end{rem*}
\begin{definition*} A graph is finite when it has finitely many nodes. \end{definition*}
\end{document}
